prompt: Summarize the supplied findings in one or two plain English sentences. Preserve the main qualification and return only the summary.

findings.pattern: For L55_N11703, the best-supported response is a conditional Colorado jurisdiction/name frame keyed by the causal prefix through the scored token—explicit Colorado, C.R.S., Denver/Boulder/Longmont, or Colorado institutions usually score high (e.g., 306.0 at a space in a C.R.S. citation, 322.0 in a Denver contact, 314.0 for Longmont–720, and blind 286 versus target 306)—often on a space or adjacent ordinary token, though explicit Colorado is not sufficient (84/87 P1 and 31/32 P5 positive, with negative Colorado-list/Plateau cases and 68446290), and the corpus is mostly near zero (median −0.048; 99.2% in −2…2). The observed negative pole is narrow: formatted other-jurisdiction administrative/contact/citation strings score low (Qinghai −46.75; North Dakota Game and Fish −39.25; blind “ (” −45.0), whereas a non-Colorado country control is −0.07 and generic phone/section strings are not negative (+3.69/+26.88), so broad non-Colorado place-name or format-alone suppression is rejected. These are measured but sparse/selected observations; the route accuracy (53.3% versus 13.3%, n=15 saved test split, including a p2→n2 counterexample) is split-limited, and the negative pole remains a hypothesis outside the exemplified administrative/citation/grant blocks.
findings.strength: Strong positive responses occur in Colorado-framed prefixes (Denver contact 322; Longmont contact 314; C.R.S. citation 306; blind maximum 286 vs target 306), and at aligned scored spaces within the replacement span of `Contact:` the Longmont frame scored product 304 (gate 17.875, up 17.0) versus Fort Collins 217 (gate 16.75, up 12.9375), with the −87.0 change decomposing into −16.84 gate and −70.33 up; sampled gate/up signs are mostly +/+ in positive bins and +/- in negative bins. The negative pole is narrow and observed on other-jurisdiction administrative strings (ND Game and Fish −39.25; Qinghai −46.75; blind minimum −45 vs target −44.5), while generic controls are weak or positive (non-Colorado country −0.07; generic phone +3.69; generic section +26.88) and the equal-quota spectrum is mostly near zero (median −0.048) with no-visible-cue positions at both tails. Route prediction reached 53.3% versus 13.3% baseline only on the saved test split (n=15), with an atlas-a14 predicted-p2/actual-n2 counterexample, so the Colorado frame is supported but broad non-Colorado suppression and generalization remain limited hypotheses.
findings.mechanism: At the aligned scored space in the `Contact: {slot}.` template (same-template, same-position, not an other-jurisdiction control), the native SiLU(gate)×up product fell from 304.0 for Longmont, CO (gate 17.875, up 17.0) to 217.0 for Fort Collins, CO (gate 16.75, up 12.9375), decomposed as −16.84 from gate and −70.33 from up (0.172 residual), so the drop is mostly `up`. Ablating L55_N11703 across 80 cases gave median KL 0.00342 versus 0.000227 for same-position controls, strongest on strong-positive cases (0.362 vs 0.000279), smaller on strong-negative (0.00622 vs 0.000469) and medium (0.00262 vs 0.000316), near control for weak cases (0.000245 vs 0.000081), and mixed on controlled Colorado contact/URL probes. The 40 saved RelP atlas graphs show large positive incoming flow for Colorado/local-contact prefixes (graph-1 activation 332; graph-3 314) and negative flow for “Qinghai” (graph-2 −46.5), but these are attributional route observations using separate-sample readers with no same-position intervention controls, so downstream causality is supported but not uniform.
findings.open_questions: The most important unresolved alternative is that L55_N11703 tracks a generic administrative/contact/citation format rather than a Colorado/jurisdiction frame: the negative pole is narrow (N2 33/35 and N4 17/17 negative, but Montana 406 and Utah 801 civic contacts are positive and the Basque Club 775/435 contact is a boundary case), and while a North Dakota Game and Fish administrative/phone prefix is strongly negative (−39.25), generic phone and section strings are not (+3.69 and +26.88). A same-template, same-position sweep crossing Colorado and other-jurisdiction contact/citation/grant strings, with measured ablations against same-position controls, could distinguish these accounts; current controlled Colorado contact/URL probes were mixed (median KL 0.150 vs 0.000268 controls), so the jurisdiction-specific reading remains a hypothesis rather than a settled causal finding.

output.text: For neuron L55_N11703, strong positive responses appear in Colorado-framed jurisdiction/name contexts—especially administrative, contact, and citation strings—while a few formatted other-jurisdiction strings are negative, but this is sparse/selected evidence with limited generalization and no established broad non-Colorado suppression. The main qualification is that the neuron may instead track a generic administrative/contact/citation format rather than a Colorado-specific frame.
